recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見真皮淺層血管周圍與附屬器周圍的淋巴球浸潤，並有細胞散入表皮；此倍率本身並不特異，需高倍與免疫染色及 HTLV-1 檢驗佐證 ATLL。
features: Superficial and mid-dermal perivascular lymphoid infiltrates in a patchy distribution
Denser band-like infiltrate along a follicular/adnexal structure on the right
Mild focal lymphocyte infiltration of the lower epidermis
Epidermis with compact orthokeratosis and no significant spongiosis
Individual cell cytology not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of skin shows patchy superficial and mid-dermal perivascular lymphoid infiltrates, with a denser infiltrate surrounding an adnexal structure and focal extension into the lower epidermis. The epidermis shows compact orthokeratosis without prominent spongiosis. Cytologic atypia cannot be assessed at this power. In conjunction with higher-power morphology, immunophenotype and HTLV-1 status, the findings are compatible with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; the pattern alone is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: MF also shows superficial perivascular and epidermotropic T cells; distinction requires HTLV-1 serology and clinical/blood findings rather than low-power pattern.
Reactive dermatitis lacks cytologically atypical cells on high power and usually shows spongiosis or interface change with eosinophils.
T-PLL cutis produces perivascular/periadnexal infiltrates of small-medium TCL1+ cells without HTLV-1 association.
